# Fran Murphy Law

> Personal injury law firm based in St. Clair Shores, Michigan. Serving injured individuals and families across Southeast Michigan — Macomb, Wayne, and Oakland counties. Free consultations. No fees unless you win.

Fran Murphy Law is a small, client-focused personal injury firm. Attorney Frances Murphy handles cases personally, offering one-on-one representation for car accidents, dog bites, slip and falls, premises liability, PIP benefits disputes, and other injury claims. Attorney Mark Cardellio joined the firm in July 2024 and focuses on personal injury, civil litigation, and criminal defense support.

**Address:** 27735 Jefferson Ave, St. Clair Shores, MI 48081
**Phone:** 586-552-5473
**Availability:** 24/7
**Consultations:** Free
**Fees:** Contingency only — no fees unless compensation is recovered

## Attorneys

- [About Frances Murphy & Mark Cardellio](https://www.franmurphylaw.com/about/): Bios for both attorneys, including education, bar background, and areas of focus.

## Practice Areas

- [Personal Injury Overview](https://www.franmurphylaw.com/personal-injury/): General overview of personal injury law in Michigan, types of claims, damages available, and how to file.
- [Auto Accidents](https://www.franmurphylaw.com/auto-accidents/): Car and truck accident claims across Southeast Michigan.
- [Dog Bite](https://www.franmurphylaw.com/dog-bite-st-clair-shores/): Michigan strict liability dog bite law; compensation for injuries, trauma, and scarring.
- [Personal Insurance Protection (PIP) Benefits](https://www.franmurphylaw.com/personal-insurance-protection-benefits/): Michigan no-fault PIP claims; medical expenses, lost wages, replacement services.
- [Premises Liability](https://www.franmurphylaw.com/premises-liability/): Injuries on someone else's property due to negligent maintenance or failure to warn.
- [Provider Actions Law](https://www.franmurphylaw.com/provider-actions-law/): Claims against healthcare providers, assisted living facilities, and nursing homes for inadequate care or elder neglect.
- [Serious Impairment of a Body Function](https://www.franmurphylaw.com/serious-impairment-of-a-body-function/): Michigan threshold standard for non-economic damages in auto accident cases.
- [Slip and Fall Law](https://www.franmurphylaw.com/slip-and-fall-law/): Slip, trip, and fall claims; negligence standards; Michigan statute of limitations (3 years).
- [What to Do After a Car Accident](https://www.franmurphylaw.com/what-should-i-do-if-im-injured-in-a-car-accident/): Step-by-step guidance for accident victims.
